Owen - Sales: Loss  Sterling Bank walked because they required HSM-backed keys and SOC2 Type II evidence; timeline mismatch.
Lina - Eng: Sterling tech note: very long transcripts exposed tail latency and audit requirements. We can propose a scoped on-prem/HSM POC and an audit shim.
Grace - CEO: Action items: 1) sales battlecard on compliance gaps; 2) Dedicated onboarding checklist; 3) short engineering runbook for long-sequence customers. Maya own 1+2? Lina own 3?
Maya - Product: I can own battlecard + checklist; will need Sales + CS reviewers. Owen/Priya can you review?
Owen - Sales: Happy to review; nominate Nate from AE as well. Please include a 1-page RFP risk blurb.
Priya - Customer Success: I'll post the affected deal list by EOD.
Lina - Eng: I'll draft the long-seq runbook and a tiny prefix-cache snippet. ETA next Tue.
